title: Resuming after Blakeney's illness
summary: Redd opens a second session on June 24, 1982, in Pasadena and explains the interview is going back chronologically after his illness.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: Good afternoon, once more we are in the comfortable setting of the home of Mr. Andrew Blakeney in Pasadena, California on June 24, 1982.

Due to circumstances beyond our control, that being Mr. Blakeney's sudden serious illness just a few hours after our last interview, we must regress chronologically with Mr. Blakeney as he continues his oral history interview.
His recovery has been marvelous for which we are all so very grateful. We now begin with the year 1935 and his experiences as a member of the Lionel Hampton Orchestra in Los Angeles.
